changes.old:
"Just you wait and see what I've got in store for you!"
A gun imbued with evil magic and loaded with (you guessed it) evil magic bullets. She was forged by a lackluster witch who favored physical combat to relying on spells. A real dazzler out on the battlefield, the sight of Solanda's magical bullets sparking and whooshing elegantly through the air has led some to describe her as a one-woman circus.
